reason: A client-side DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that groups execution steps into collapsible process boxes, primarily improving interface layout and readability.

summaries.zh: 这是一个用于 DeepSeek Harness Web 的客户端界面插件，可将执行步骤整理为可展开和折叠的过程框。
summaries.en: A client-side DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that organizes execution steps into expandable and collapsible process boxes.

capabilities: modifies client-side web UI structure and styles
adds expand/collapse controls to execution-process content
cleans up injected UI elements when stopped
